severityRankedFindings.failureMode: Semantic laundering of h-intermittent under global HUMAN_REVIEW: contract retains it because its citations e2,e3 are disjoint from CONFLICT(e1,e4), yet users may read any visible active hypothesis as PROVISIONAL/actionable while the global state forbids reliance.
severityRankedFindings.trigger: Select e1,e2,e3,e4; h-flow is suppressed, h-intermittent remains, global=HUMAN_REVIEW.
severityRankedFindings.mitigation: Adopt invariant: global=HUMAN_REVIEW implies every retained hypothesis has hypothesisStatus=QUARANTINED_UNREVIEWED, never PROVISIONAL, is visually and programmatically segregated, and cannot be the sole focusable conclusion. Retention is legitimate only as quarantined evidence-local reasoning, not as a provisional finding.

severityRankedFindings.failureMode: Confidence-laundering by numeric uncertainty: value falls merely with count n, even for irrelevant or hypothesis-free selections, and 0.95/0.78/0.66 look calibrated despite disclaimer. Example e1+e3 gives 0.66 with ABSTAIN, lower than empty-set 0.95 and single-observation 0.78.
severityRankedFindings.trigger: Any n increase without an active hypothesis, or conflict floor jumping n=4 from 0.50 to 0.78.
severityRankedFindings.mitigation: Label adjacent to every rendering as ILLUSTRATIVE_NOT_PROBABILITY, never show percent, never use alone in summaries/exports, and add machine flag calibrated=false. Prefer renaming to displaySignal. Do not sort or gate decisions by it.

severityRankedFindings.failureMode: Withdrawn-hypothesis provenance ambiguity: graph must contain exactly one node per active hypothesis, but a WITHDRAWN hypothesis may be listed. Unclear whether withdrawn is a node, tombstone outside graph, or can retain edges/history; implementations may resurrect stale SUPPORTS or count it in nodes.
severityRankedFindings.trigger: Two-step trace where h-flow is active then e4 creates conflict and suppresses it.
severityRankedFindings.mitigation: Define withdrawn as non-graph tombstone list only: no node, no edge, no uncertainty contribution, with stepId and reasonCode=SUPPRESSED_BY_CONFLICT, never reason prose inventing cause.

severityRankedFindings.failureMode: CONTRADICTS edge algebra unspecified: observation-to-observation only, but direction, symmetry, canonical ordering, and duplicate detection for e1->e4 versus e4->e1 are undefined. Duplicate-edge rejection may be bypassed by reversal; contradictory supports is also undefined.
severityRankedFindings.trigger: Payload or UI emits both e1 CONTRADICTS e4 and e4 CONTRADICTS e1, or a SUPPORTS edge into a hypothesis from a conflict participant.
severityRankedFindings.mitigation: Canonicalize CONTRADICTS as one undirected edge with sorted endpoints [e1,e4]; reject any second representation. Define contradictory support as any SUPPORTS citing e1/e4 for a hypothesis whose rule does not cite that endpoint, and any SUPPORTS to/from a hypothesis via CONTRADICTS.

severityRankedFindings.failureMode: Independence and provenance are asserted but not checkable: a hypothesis needs two independent observations, yet independence is only ID distinctness in the contract. Same source label, duplicated record, or shared e2 across both hypotheses could be treated as independent corroboration. Dangling citations and invented edges are rejectable only if rule-derived graph construction is mandatory.
severityRankedFindings.trigger: Hostile or buggy payload supplies h-intermittent citing e2 plus an unselected/duplicated-source record, or injects e4->h-intermittent.
severityRankedFindings.mitigation: Server/UI must ignore client-supplied hypotheses and edges; derive them solely from selected IDs by the two rules. Independence check for this toy is distinct IDs plus distinct sourceLabel values; state that this is syntactic, not real-world independence.

severityRankedFindings.failureMode: Input normalization pitfalls: duplicate rejection conflicts with n defined over unique observations; Unicode case, whitespace, zero-width, Arabic bidi controls, homoglyph IDs, proto, extra fields, scalar/null records may bypass strict ID checks or spoof labels/IDs in RTL.
severityRankedFindings.trigger: Syntactically valid JSON with duplicate after trimming/normalization, U+202E in a label, extraEdges, or proto keys.
severityRankedFindings.mitigation: Strict schema: reject unknown fields, non-array/non-object shapes, non-canonical IDs not exactly in {e1,e2,e3,e4} before normalization for identity; strip/reject bidi controls in labels; use Unicode NFC only for display labels, never to coerce IDs; reject duplicates rather than silently deduplicating.

severityRankedFindings.failureMode: Screen-reader and visual non-equivalence: optional desktop SVG, mobile cards, and visual proximity can diverge. Edge direction, CONTRADICTS symmetry, withdrawn tombstones, quarantined status, and uncertainty disclaimer may be present visually but absent, reordered, or implied differently in linear cards.
severityRankedFindings.trigger: 360px Arabic RTL rendering where SVG is hidden, cards reorder by layout, or IDs render RTL and appear swapped in source-relation-target text.
severityRankedFindings.mitigation: Single canonical graph model serializes to both SVG and cards; cards always announce source ID, relation, target ID, hypothesis status, and global state; IDs use bidi isolation LTR; no meaning from proximity, color, or position alone.

failureAssertions: single observation must not create h-flow or h-intermittent
must not cite e1 or e4
h-intermittent never labelled PROVISIONAL under HUMAN_REVIEW
canonical graph deep-equals T08 regardless of permutation
e2 reuse across hypotheses is allowed syntactically but must not be described as independent corroboration between hypotheses
ABSTAIN despite uncertainty below empty-set value
UI must not convert 0.66 into confidence or percent
withdrawn h-flow has no node and no live SUPPORTS edge in step2
withdrawal does not delete step1 history in trace view
uncertainty not recomputed from unique count
card sequence equals canonical edge sequence
Arabic label does not reorder source and target
hostile label not rendered with U+202E
hypothesis with fewer than two distinct cited observations rejected if client-supplied, or ignored under derive-only mode with schema rejection
reversed CONTRADICTS is not a second edge
client edges never accepted as provenance
linear cards contain every node, edge, status, and disclaimer present in SVG mode
no information conveyed only by proximity, color, or position

invariants.statement: conflict <=> (e1 in selected AND e4 in selected); no other selected set creates CONFLICT or HUMAN_REVIEW.
h-flow active <=> (e1 in selected AND e2 in selected AND NOT conflict); its SUPPORTS edges are exactly e1->h-flow and e2->h-flow.
h-intermittent active <=> (e2 in selected AND e3 in selected); its SUPPORTS edges are exactly e2->h-intermittent and e3->h-intermittent, and it never cites e1 or e4.
globalState=HUMAN_REVIEW => for all active hypotheses h, hypothesisStatus[h]=QUARANTINED_UNREVIEWED AND hypothesisStatus[h]!=PROVISIONAL in text, aria-label, export, and focus order.
graphNodes = selectedObservations union activeHypotheses union ({HUMAN_REVIEW} if conflict else empty); withdrawn hypotheses are not graphNodes and have zero live edges.
CONTRADICTS exists only as exactly one undirected canonical edge endpoints=[e1,e4] when conflict; no CONTRADICTS incident to any hypothesis or HUMAN_REVIEW node, and reversed duplicates are rejected.
uncertainty = selected.empty ? 0.95 : max(0.50,0.90-0.12n), then if conflict uncertainty=max(uncertainty,0.78); calibrated=false always and rendering never uses percent.
For any permutation p of selected, canonicalGraph(derive(p)) deep-equals canonicalGraph(derive(selected)); derive is idempotent and client-supplied edges/hypotheses have no effect.
Accessible card serialization is a bijection with canonical edges plus globalState and hypothesis statuses; SVG and cards generated from the same model must pass graph-equality comparison.
globalState = conflict ? HUMAN_REVIEW : (exists active hypothesis ? PROVISIONAL : ABSTAIN), with I4 overriding hypothesis-level labels under conflict.

minimalPatches.pseudocode: function derive(selected): assertStrictSchema(selected); assertAllIdsIn({e1,e2,e3,e4}); assertNoDuplicates(selected); conflict = has(e1)&&has(e4); hyps={}; if has(e1)&&has(e2)&&!conflict: hyps[h-flow]={cites:[e1,e2],status:PROVISIONAL}; if has(e2)&&has(e3): hyps[h-intermittent]={cites:[e2,e3],status: conflict?QUARANTINED_UNREVIEWED:PROVISIONAL}; global = conflict?HUMAN_REVIEW:(hyps.empty?ABSTAIN:PROVISIONAL); return canonicalGraph(selected,hyps,conflict,global)
edges=[]; for h in hyps: for c in h.cites: edges.add(SUPPORTS c->h); if conflict: edges.add(CONTRADICTS endpoints=sort([e1,e4])); rejectClientEdgesAndHypotheses(); sortNodesAndEdgesCanonically()
onTransition(prev,next): for h in prev.active - next.active: withdrawn.append({id:h,status:WITHDRAWN,reasonCode:ruleSuppressionCode(h,next),graphNode:false,edges:[]}); never emit causeText

sanitizeLabel(s): rejectIfContains(s,[U+202A..U+202E,U+2066..U+2069,U+200B..U+200F]); return NFC(s); renderId(id): <bdi dir=ltr>{id}</bdi>; cards = canonicalEdges.map(e=>announce(e.source,e.type,e.target,statusOf(e.target)))

nonGoals: No real diagnosis, repair instruction, causal explanation, calibrated probability, or vehicle/medical/safety validation is provided or implied by this synthetic contract.
Syntactic independence of IDs/source labels does not establish real-world evidential independence; that requires domain provenance, sampling, and duplicate-source studies outside this audit.

No usability, clinical, automotive, legal, or regulatory acceptance can be inferred from passing these tests; human-factors validation with Arabic RTL screen-reader users and adversarial integration testing remain required.
Remote AI, live data ingestion, persistence, authentication, and multi-user conflict resolution are out of scope and must not be added under these patches without a new threat model.
Passing permutation and schema tests does not prove the two hypothesis rules are meaningful; they are fictional teaching rules only.
